about: Identity slurs (race or ethnicity, sexual orientation or gender identity, disability) kept out of the shipped lexicon (decision D7, ADR-data-004). SHA-256 of the normalized word, so no file in the repo spells them; possessives ("x's") are matched by their stem. `code` is the word's keypad code, so a test can recover the word by trying every spelling of those keys. Selected on 2026-11-06 by the decoding-quality owner from the LDNOOBW English list (CC BY 4.0, fetched into .cache/, never committed): the listed words that are in the wordfreq lexicon and are slurs; general profanity and sexual words on that list are kept on purpose. Used by scripts/build_lexicon.py (--slurs), src/offensive.ts and test/data.test.ts.
